runs.narrative:
Living in a cramped galley apartment, I have spent the day navigating the constraints of my space. Salt has got into everything, creating a salty atmosphere that clings to everything. Despite the challenges, this cramped galley plays host to my daily routine, including potting lentil sprouts for the next meal and meticulously cleaning my living quarters, ensuring a clean space amidst the ocean of salt.

Directly after lunch, I found myself pondering what I would do today, when I thought of seeking solace amidst nature. I closed the southern hatch under the floor to prevent more salt from entering, straightening up my workspace as I awaited a potential conversation. With a sensitive eye on the stability of my living space, I then proceeded to tightly close it again, securing it against gusts and ensuring there was no accidental shift of my furniture or spillage of food onto my slate of tasks. As I quietly closed the hatch, verifying that it was secure, my attention turned back to my original quest—inspecting and securing my living area in preparation for the upcoming day.
